summary: thiscall unpack of a compact 2-component int16 vector into floats. Writes this[20] (offset 0x28) scaled by 0.001953125 (1/512) to a2 (X), zeroes the DWORD at a2+4 (Y), and writes this[21] (offset 0x2A) scaled by 0.001953125 to a2+8 (Z). Returns the output pointer a2. Used on the per-frame path by VehiclePhysicsTimeStep and AudioParameterInterpolation.

local_names.a2: output float buffer (X at +0, Y at +4 zeroed, Z at +8)

operations.description: Zero the output DWORD at a2+4 (Y component) before writing the X/Z components.
Scale int16 this[20] (offset 0x28) by 0.001953125 (1/512) and write the float to a2 (X component).
Scale int16 this[21] (offset 0x2A) by 0.001953125 (1/512) and write the float to a2+8 (Z component).
Return the output pointer a2 (result = a2).
Used on the per-frame path by VehiclePhysicsTimeStep and AudioParameterInterpolation for packed-vector decoding.
